title: Uniform provisions concerning the approval of: I. an airbag module for a replacement airbag system; II. a replacement steering wheel equipped with an airbag module of an approved type; III. a replacement airbag system other than that installed in a steering wheel
scope_summary: Approves aftermarket equipment: airbag modules for replacement airbag systems, replacement steering wheels equipped with an approved airbag module, and replacement airbag systems other than those installed in steering wheels. The airbag modules are intended for motor vehicles, while the replacement steering wheels and replacement airbag systems are approved for use on M1 and N1 vehicles, with approvals tied to listed vehicle types.
scope_quote: This Regulation applies to the following aftermarket equipment: 1.1. to airbag modules for replacement airbag systems intended to be installed on motor vehicles; 1.2. to replacement steering wheels for vehicles of categories M1 and N1, equipped with an airbag module of an approved type and intended to be installed as an additional restraint system beside safety-belts and other restraint systems in power-driven vehicles, i.e. a system which, in the event of a severe impact, automatically deploys a flexible structure intended to reduce the severity of injuries of the occupants; 1.3. to replacement airbag systems other than those installed in steering wheels and equipped with airbag modules of an approved type as an additional restraint system beside safety-belts and other restraint systems in powerdriven vehicles of categories M1 and N1
applies_to_components: airbag module for a replacement airbag system
replacement steering wheel equipped with an airbag module
replacement airbag system other than that installed in a steering wheel
relation_to_other_regulations: Airbag modules approved under this Regulation are a prerequisite for approval of replacement steering wheels and of replacement airbag systems under the same Regulation.
Annex 8 'H' point determination procedure refers to SAE J826 (3-D H machine).

The replacement equipment is intended as an additional restraint beside safety-belts and other restraint systems (cf. UN R16, R14, R12, R94, R95), but the text does not explicitly cite these Regulations in the opening sections.

defined_terms.definition: A group of components which, once installed in vehicle(s), perform all functions provided by the manufacturer, comprising at minimum a release unit activating one or more airbag modules and the wiring harness, if present.
A flexible material forming an enclosed volume that receives the gas from the inflator and restrains the occupant.
The smallest sub-assembly comprising the energy source for its deployment and the airbag involved in the deployment.
An aftermarket steering wheel (equipped with an airbag module) supplied to modify a motor vehicle that may vary in functional dimensions, form and/or material from the original steering wheel.
An aftermarket airbag system supplied to modify a motor vehicle that may vary in functional dimensions, form, materials or operation from any original airbag system for that vehicle.
Device intended to protect the driver of a vehicle in the event of a frontal collision.
Device intended to protect front seat passenger(s) other than the driver in the event of a frontal collision.
Device intended to protect passenger(s) in seats other than the front seats in the event of a frontal collision.
Device intended to protect the front seat occupant(s) in the event of a lateral collision.
The moment at which, in an impact causing airbag deployment, the components producing deployment are irreversibly actuated.
The sub-assembly comprising all components permitting the collision to be detected and producing release.
All electrical conductors and connections linking the various parts of the complete airbag system to each other and possibly to the vehicle.
The mass of the vehicle in running order, unoccupied and unladen but complete with fuel, coolant, lubricant, tools and spare wheel if standard.

applicability_hints: Applies only to aftermarket (replacement) airbag equipment, not to original-equipment airbags fitted by the vehicle manufacturer.
An aftermarket steering wheel fitted with an airbag (e.g. sport/tuning steering wheel) falls under this Regulation, including its hub/adapter, which must also bear the approval mark.
Any aftermarket airbag module (driver, passenger, rear, side) requires approval as a module before it may be used in a replacement steering wheel or replacement airbag system.
Replacement airbag systems include release/control units and wiring harnesses as part of the system.
Side (lateral collision) airbags for front seat occupants are covered as Category D.
Steering wheel and airbag system approvals are linked to specific vehicle types listed in the approval; changing vehicle types requires extension.
Airbag module type is defined by cover material/structure, propellant composition and fixation method, so a changed cover or inflator may create a new type.
